encounters.title: Halvor Compound Ambush
encounters.description: Guards respond in force if the party goes loud during Mira's rescue.
encounters.body:
# Halvor Compound Ambush

## When this triggers
The party enters Halvor's compound violently — Mira's rescue by force. Silent infiltration avoids this entirely. Negotiation defuses it (Halvor himself appears at round 2 — see his cue card).

## Tactics
- **Bandit Captain** stays back and directs — issues *Parry* reactions to protect the front line. Retreats through the back door if reduced below 20 HP.
- **Thugs** engage front line, use Pack Tactics — try to keep pairs adjacent to the same PC.
- **Watch guards** (arrive turn 3) enter through the front — noise from the compound has reached the street. They're not Halvor's — they're the real Ironhold Watch. If the party surrenders to them, this is de-escalation, not defeat.

## Terrain
Compound courtyard: 40×40 ft, cover along the walls, a well at the centre, the back warehouse door (locked, DC 15 to bash). Mira and children in the warehouse — DO NOT let a stray AoE hit that door.

## Adjustments
- If party goes stealth-first: skip Captain + Thugs, only the guards arrive if noise breaks out.
- If Halvor appears in negotiation: replace Captain's turn with Halvor pleading. See his cue card.

encounters.title: Naturus Cult Cell Ambush
encounters.description: A cell of Kaelith's followers moves against the party — cultists, a Fanatic, and one wight-touched leader.
encounters.body:
# Naturus Cult Cell Ambush

## When this triggers
Kaelith learns the party is investigating her network too closely. She sends a cell to make an example. Works as a night ambush at their inn, or a street daylight strike (with Watch reactions incoming).

## Tactics
- **Wight** leads. Uses **Life Drain** on the highest-visible-HP target, tries to force PC HP-max reduction. Killed PCs rise as zombies on the next midnight (Kaelith's design — a spare Naturus recruit).
- **Cult Fanatic** stays in the second rank, casts Hold Person on the biggest melee threat (Orin), then Spiritual Weapon.
- **Cultists** swarm in pairs. Break morale if the Fanatic drops (DC 12 Wis, or flee).

## Terrain
Adjustable. Street version: cramped alley + rooftops for a Scout ambusher. Inn version: common room, tables as cover, upper floor for the Fanatic.

## Adjustments
- Party level 5: swap the Wight for a Ghoul, drop 2 cultists.
- Party level 7+: add one Ghast and one more Fanatic.

encounters.title: Wilderness — Wolf Pack + Dire Alpha
encounters.description: A wolf pack led by a dire wolf. Standard travel-day threat.
encounters.body:
# Wolf Pack + Dire Alpha

## When this triggers
Any wilderness travel day. Random encounter. Filler / breathing space between plot beats.

## Tactics
- **Dire Wolf** leads a Pack Tactics charge on the most isolated PC.
- **Wolves** work in pairs — one engages, one flanks.
- All wolves flee at 25% health of the pack (i.e., when 3 of 4 wolves + the dire wolf are wounded or dropped).

## Terrain
Forest edge or open ground. If forest: cover for both sides. If open: PCs get first shot from ranged; wolves close hard.
